metadata.title: Reviews | Asleep
metadata.description: Read what customers say about Asleep mattresses. Ratings, stories, and press coverage.

hero.title: Don't judge a mattress by its box.
hero.body: To us, Asleep is perfect and we'll do everything possible to get your relationship with Asleep off to a great start. We, and many future Asleep users with us, are looking forward to your adventures together!

shareSheet.title: Tell us what you think of Asleep here
shareSheet.productLabel: Which product do you want to review?*
shareSheet.reviewBodyPlaceholder: Tell us more about your experience
shareSheet.successBody: We’ve received your review. It helps other sleepers find their perfect mattress.

items.title: Fast delivery, great service
items.body: I was a bit skeptical about a memory-foam pillow, but this Asleep pillow changed my mind — beautiful material with comfort I can still adjust. Customer service is also quick, involved, and flexible!

items.title: Very happy with my new mattress
items.body: I've finally found what's perfect for my needs in terms of comfort, and I'm delighted. I would have liked to hear about Asleep sooner.

items.title: No more overheating at night
items.body: The ventilation system really works — I no longer wake up feeling too hot at night. Plus, the materials feel premium and sustainable, which matters a lot to me. You can feel the quality. Five stars from me!

items.title: The best support I've ever felt in a mattress
items.body: I've tried several 'premium' mattresses before, but nothing comes close. You can feel it was designed with real sleep science behind it. The support is amazing and I fall asleep faster and deeper.

items.title: Back pain gone after just one night!
items.body: After sleeping on Asleep for just one night, I woke up without any back pain for the first time in months. It truly adapts to your body and offers just the right balance between firmness and comfort. Delivery was fast and customer service was super helpful. Highly recommend!

items.title: Perfect for couples with different comfort needs
items.body: I was a bit skeptical at first, but the 120-day trial gave me the confidence to try it out. Best decision ever. My wife prefers a softer feel, while I like it firmer. This mattress somehow works perfectly for both of us. Impressive!

items.title: Love it!
items.body: Its adaptability has reconciled me with foam mattresses: I've finally been able to adjust a mattress to the firmness I like.

items.title: Perfect for my back!
items.body: I've finally found the perfect support for my back. I fall asleep much faster and wake up far less during the night.

items.title: Fulfills its functions
items.body: Adds an extra touch of comfort that's very nice.
